_comment: Host this file at the Rules URL (default: the raw.githubusercontent.com path in background.js). Bump 'version' and add entries here to push a fix to every installed copy without releasing a new extension. popupSelectors/backdropSelectors are CSS selectors passed only to querySelectorAll; jsonPopupKeys are JSON key names compared against object keys in page-hooks.js; popupText are substrings compared (lowercased) against a notification's textContent in content.js to catch the toast-style 'Experiencing interruptions?' nag. Nothing here is ever executed as code. Note: the bare 'yt-notification-action-renderer' selector below blanket-removes that generic toast on v1.2.x (which has no text matching); v1.3.0+ text-gates it via popupText so ordinary toasts are kept.
